units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 5) be courteous in dealings with citizens;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 6) respect the moral customs and traditions of the peoples of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 7) take account of the cultural and other characteristics of different ethnic and social groups and religious denominations;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 8) promote interethnic and interfaith harmony;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 9) prevent conflict situations capable of damaging their reputation or the authority of the local self-government body.
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant who is a manager is obliged to prevent cases in which municipal servants are compelled to participate in the activities of political parties or other public or religious associations.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.label: Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 1. A citizen applying for a municipal service position and a municipal servant shall submit to the employer’s representative (employer) information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption” (hereinafter, information on income, property and property-related obligations), in the cases established by that Federal Law. Such information shall be submitted in the procedure, within the time limits and in the form established for submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations by state civil servants of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 1.1. A municipal servant holding a municipal service position included in the relevant list must submit information on expenditure provided for by Federal Law No. 230-FZ of 3 December 2012 “On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income” (hereinafter, information on expenditure), in the procedure and form established for submission of information on expenditure by state civil servants of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 1.2. Monitoring the correspondence of a municipal servant’s expenditure and that of their spouse and minor children to their income is carried out in the procedure provided for by the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption” and the Federal Law “On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income”, normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation, laws and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow, and municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 2. Information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted by a municipal servant under this Article are confidential, unless federal laws classify them as information constituting a state secret or another secret protected by federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 3. Information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted by a municipal servant under this Article may not be used to establish or determine the solvency of the municipal servant, their spouse or minor children, or to collect, directly or indirectly, donations (contributions) to funds of religious or other public associations, other organisations, or individuals.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 4. Persons responsible for disclosing information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted by a municipal servant under this Article, or for using that information for purposes not provided for by federal laws, shall be liable in accordance with federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 5. A municipal servant’s failure to submit information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure where its submission is mandatory, or submission of knowingly incomplete information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure, constitutes an offence entailing dismissal from municipal service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 5.1. A municipal servant’s submission of knowingly inaccurate information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure constitutes an offence entailing dismissal from municipal service.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 6. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted under Parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article by municipal servants holding the specified positions; of the accuracy and completeness of information submitted by citizens entering municipal service in accordance with normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts; and of municipal servants’ compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and their performance of duties established by the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption”, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and this Law is carried out in the procedure determined by normative legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 7. Requests for information constituting banking, tax or other legally protected secrets, and requests to law enforcement bodies to conduct operational-search measures concerning citizens applying for municipal service positions included in the relevant list, municipal servants holding those positions, and the spouses and minor children of such citizens and municipal servants, are sent in the interests of local self-government bodies by the Mayor of Moscow in the procedure determined by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 8. Citizens applying for the position of head of administration under contract shall submit information on income, property and property-related obligations, and the person holding that position shall submit information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure, to the Mayor of Moscow in the procedure established by Law of the City of Moscow No. 64 of 17 December 2014 “On Measures to Combat Corruption in the City of Moscow”.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 9. Repealed.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 10. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted under Part 8 of this Article is carried out by decision of the Mayor of Moscow in the procedure established by the Law of the City of Moscow “On Measures to Combat Corruption in the City of Moscow”.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
units.text: 11. If verification under Part 10 of this Article reveals that the person holding the position of head of administration under contract has failed to comply with restrictions or prohibitions or to perform duties established by the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, the Federal Law “On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income”, or Federal Law No. 79-FZ of 7 May 2013 “On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, or Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments”, the Mayor of Moscow shall apply to the head of the municipal formation, the representative body or a court for early termination of the powers of the person holding the position of head of administration under contract or for another disciplinary sanction to be imposed on that person.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.label: Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 1. Citizens who have reached the age of 18, have command of the state language of the Russian Federation and meet the qualification requirements established by this Law for municipal service positions are entitled to enter municipal service, provided that none of the circumstances specified as restrictions related to municipal service apply.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 2. Upon entry into municipal service and during its performance, no direct or indirect restrictions or advantages may be established on grounds of sex, race, ethnicity, origin, property or official status, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, membership in public associations, or other circumstances unrelated to a municipal servant’s professional and work-related qualities.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 3. Upon entry into municipal service, a citizen shall submit:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 1) an application requesting admission to municipal service and appointment to a municipal service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 2) the questionnaire provided for by Article 15.2 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 3) a passport;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 4) the employment record book and/or information on employment history prepared in the procedure established by labour legislation, except where an employment agreement (contract) is concluded for the first time;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 5) a document on education and qualifications;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 6) a document confirming registration in the individual (personalized) record-keeping system, except where an employment agreement (contract) is being concluded for the first time;
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 7) a certificate of registration of the individual with the tax authority at the place of residence in the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 8) military registration documents — for persons liable for military service and persons subject to conscription;
units.label: Point 8 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 9) a medical organization’s conclusion confirming the absence of a disease preventing entry into municipal service;
units.label: Point 9 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 10) information on income, property and property-related obligations;
units.label: Point 10 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 11) other documents provided for by federal legislation.
units.label: Point 11 Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 4. Information (except information contained in the questionnaire) submitted by a citizen entering municipal service under this Law may be verified in the procedure established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 5. If verification under Part 4 of this Article establishes circumstances preventing a citizen from entering municipal service, that citizen shall be informed in writing of the reasons for refusal of entry into municipal service within three working days.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 6. A citizen enters municipal service through appointment to a municipal service position on the terms of an employment agreement in accordance with labour legislation, taking account of the specific features provided for by federal legislation and this Law. Appointment of a citizen to a municipal service position is formalised by an act of the employer’s representative (employer) appointing them to that position.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 7. The parties to the employment contract upon entry into municipal service are the employer’s representative (employer) and the municipal servant.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into municipal service
units.text: 8. A contract is concluded with a citizen entering the position of head of administration following a competition to fill that position. The procedure for filling the position of head of administration under contract and the procedure for concluding and terminating a contract with a person appointed to that position under contract are determined by the Federal Law “On the General Principles of the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation”, the Law of the City of Moscow “On the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the City of Moscow” and this Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 19. Competition for a municipal service position
units.text: Article 19. Competition for a municipal service position
units.label: Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Competition for a municipal service position
units.text: 1. When filling a municipal service position in a municipal formation, conclusion of an employment agreement may be preceded by a competition (hereinafter, the competition), during which applicants’ professional level and their compliance with the qualification requirements established for the municipal service position are assessed.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Competition for a municipal service position
units.text: 2. The cases and procedure for holding the competition are established by a municipal legal act of the representative body. The procedure must provide for publication of its conditions, information on the date, time and place, and the draft employment agreement at least 20 days before the competition. The representative body establishes the total membership of the competition commission in the municipal formation and the procedure for forming it.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Competition for a municipal service position
units.text: 3. A competition to fill the position of head of administration under contract is held in the procedure established by Article 20 of this Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
units.text: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
units.label: Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
units.text: 1. The representative body establishes the procedure for holding a competition to fill the position of head of administration under contract. The procedure must provide for publication of the competition conditions, information on the date, time and place, and the draft contract at least 20 days before the competition.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
units.text: 2. The contract terms for the head of administration are established in accordance with Article 20.1 of this Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
units.text: 3. The representative body establishes the total membership of the competition commission in the municipal formation and the procedure for forming it.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
units.text: 4. The representative body’s decision establishing the total membership of the competition commission in the municipal formation shall be sent to the Mayor of Moscow within two days of its adoption.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
units.text: 5. When the competition commission is formed, half its members are appointed by the representative body and the other half by the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
units.text: 6. The representative body appoints the head of administration from among candidates put forward by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results. Appointment shall take place within 30 days from the date on which the competition commission determines the results of the competition to fill the position of head of administration under contract.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
units.text: 7. The contract with the head of administration is concluded by the head of the municipal formation. The standard form of contract with a person appointed under contract as head of administration of an intra-city municipal formation in the City of Moscow is approved by this Law (Appendix 1).
units.label: Part 7 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
units.text: 8. The contract with the head of administration is concluded for the term of office of the representative body that decided to appoint that person as head of administration (until the day the newly elected representative body begins its work), but for no less than two years.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.label: Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 1. The representative body approves the contract terms for the head of administration insofar as they concern the exercise of powers to resolve matters of local significance.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 2. When exercising individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, transferred powers), the head of administration shall:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 1) organise and ensure the execution of transferred powers;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 2) ensure the implementation of legal acts of the City of Moscow concerning transferred powers, including legal acts of authorised executive bodies of the City of Moscow exercising state supervision over local self-government bodies’ exercise of transferred powers;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 3) submit (ensure the submission of), in the prescribed procedure, to authorised executive bodies of the City of Moscow calculations of the financial costs required to exercise transferred powers, reports on their execution, including the use of financial resources, and other documents and information related to the exercise of transferred powers;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 4) ensure the designated use and proper maintenance of material resources and the designated use of financial resources provided to local self-government bodies for the exercise of transferred powers;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 5) ensure the return to the budget of the City of Moscow of interbudgetary transfers received as subventions and not used in the current financial year;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 20.1
